Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		c: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		c.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		CardIDValidated = false and
		InputCard = null and
		result = false or
		c.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CardIDValidated = true and
		InputCard = c and
		result = true
}
